env_vm.role: Derived design-load von Mises envelope: max(lat*260N, twist*1820Nmm*kc, pry*260N, ring_c*1500N) outside 4.0 mm tip exclusion (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:389-390)
env_vm.mask_semantics: 75 cells within 4.0 mm of blade tip forced to 0.0 by producer

lat.role: Primitive DKT out-of-plane bending von Mises stress per unit lateral tip load (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:282-286)

pry.role: Primitive T6 quadratic membrane centroid von Mises stress per unit in-plane tip pry load perpendicular to ring-to-tip chord with ring bore clamped (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:312-321)
pry.admission_decision: ADMITTED into 5-map composite (Recipe A_5) and 4-primitive composite (Recipe B_4prim)

ring.role: Primitive T6 quadratic membrane centroid von Mises stress per unit ring-pull traction with grip band [76+dx, 100+dx] mm seated (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:334-344, 388)
ring.mask_semantics: 14,875 cells with x_centroid >= sx0 - 3.0 mm forced to 0.0 by producer (seated handle/blade region)

twist.role: Primitive DKT plate bending von Mises stress per unit chord-torsion slope moment at tip patch (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:283-287)

sf.role: Derived safety factor: sy100 / env_vm where env_vm > 0 else 10.0 (crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:391)
sf.exclusion_from_stress_composite_rational: Exact reciprocal transform of env_vm (clipped to 10.0 on the 75 tip-excluded cells); not an independent FEM load case

te.role: Element thickness (4-point quadrature average of decoded blade/handle thickness field; crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:260-263)
te.exclusion_from_stress_composite_rational: Geometric cross-section property, not a mechanical stress response field

envelope_load_scaling_rule.explanation: Both lat and pry primitive D1 maps are unit-response fields (MPa/N) that are each multiplied by floors::HUNTER_LATERAL_N (260 N) when forming the worst-case envelope in crates/crescent/src/fem.rs:389-390, alongside ring (1500 N) and twist (1820 Nmm).
